work.description: CCLXXVI Quum non semel: entire ten-clause Barletta chapter constitution fully read, whole PiusVII history, suppression and union into three dignities, twenty-four canons and twenty beneficiaries, all transition, rank, stipend, pension, vestment, existing Nazarene archpriest, additional praebend, chaplain, church-property, accounting, feast-office and throne provisions, executor/subdelegation, validation, prescribed silence, derogation, sanctio and datum LF54828–54832. Exact XML leaves413–415 normal substantive left/right and page continuation order, with all own notes retained. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
